title: Tagging Verification Detail
description: Global/core iDoXs drilldown for Tagging Verification, modeled after WERT legacy rptTaggingVerificationDetail2.php.

source.sql: select top 5000 convert(date, i.VISIT_DATE) as [date], convert(varchar(12), i.VISIT_DATE, 114) as [time], ltrim(rtrim(cast(i.MD_ID as varchar(128)))) as md_id, upper(ltrim(rtrim(concat(isnull(d.LAST_NAME, ''), ', ', isnull(d.FIRST_NAME, ''))))) as md_name, dc.CLINIC_ADDRESS as [address], case when s.SPECIALTY_DESCRIPTION is null then dc.SPECIALTY else s.SPECIALTY_DESCRIPTION end as specialty, concat(ltrim(rtrim(cast(i.FREQUENCY as varchar(32)))), 'x') as frequency, cast(i.VISIT_NUMBER as int) as visit_no, concat(ltrim(rtrim(cast(i.PSR_ID as varchar(128)))), '_', ltrim(rtrim(cast(i.MD_ID as varchar(128)))), '_', cast(pit.[YEAR] as varchar(8)), cast(pit.[MONTH] as varchar(8)), cast(i.VISIT_NUMBER as varchar(8))) as signature, 'Notes' as notes from [dbo].[ITINERARY] i join [dbo].[PSR_ITINERARY] pit on i.PSR_ID = pit.PSR_ID and i.ITINERARY_DATE = pit.ITINERARY_DATE join [dbo].[DOCTOR] d on i.MD_ID = d.MD_ID left join [dbo].[SPECIALTY] s on d.SPECIALTY_CODE = s.SPECIALTY_CODE left join [dbo].[doctor_clinic] dc on dc.MD_ID = d.MD_ID and dc.TERRITORY_ID = i.TERRITORY_ID where ltrim(rtrim(cast(i.TERRITORY_ID as varchar(128)))) = @territoryId and i.VISIT_DATE >= @visitDate and i.VISIT_DATE < dateadd(day, 1, @visitDate) {{territoryPredicate:i.TERRITORY_ID}} order by i.VISIT_DATE

dataSourceDefinition.grain: one visited itinerary row for selected territory/date
dataSourceDefinition.notes: Modern drilldown equivalent of WERT rptTaggingVerificationDetail2.php. Signature is emitted as a deterministic reference string for now; legacy rendered an image URL. Notes is a placeholder for the legacy DoctorCallNotes popup.
